summary: A 1933 observation tower and camp gave way to a 20-foot treated timber L-4 tower in 1947; both were gone by 1968. No source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says it was removed in 1968 and firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. Both give 1968, so the story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register and firelookout.com agree on the 1933 and 1947 towers and the 1968 end. The Oregon page adds the 1936 panorama, the 1940 plan and the 1941 staffing, and marks the tower removed without a date. The brief has no height or design, so facts were added from the register. The Oregon Hikers Johnson Butte Trailhead (42.19566, -123.99261, reached by forest roads from Brookings) is roughly 7 km from the register coordinates and does not mention a lookout, so it was not cited. The hiiker.app Johnson Butte Trail is also unconnected to the lookout. No source describes the site today.
